Paw-to-Paw support

Paw-to-Paw is an invite-only app for neighbours in Tengah, run by one person. If something is wrong, you can reach him two ways.

Message JK

In the app, tap Something went wrong on the home screen. It opens WhatsApp to JK.

Or email jktoh@icloud.com.

Can't sign in?

Forgot your PIN, or on a new phone? JK can give you a code. Message him as above, and he'll give you a one-time code to link your phone again. Then you choose a new PIN.

Want to leave?

At the bottom of the home screen, tap Leave the pack, then type LEAVE to confirm. Your name, number, block and answers are wiped, and so are your dogs' details. Photos taken at your handovers are removed by JK within a week.

What the app keeps, and why, is on the privacy page.

Last checked 2 Oct 2026.
